findings.summary: Section 3 mixes two unrelated topics, and its comparison table has only one row, so it does little as a visual.
findings.evidence: "3. Mistakes and Nulls" lists "Mutating a key after insertion" and "Overriding equals without hashCode", then a table with only "Null key | one allowed | no | no", then the "Unfindable entry" callout.
findings.fix: Split into "Common Mistake" (the two bullets plus the unfindable-entry explanation) and a separate "Null handling" line. Either add rows to the table (thread-safe, ordering) or replace it with one bullet: "HashMap allows one null key; Hashtable and ConcurrentHashMap allow none".

findings.summary: The claim that a null key always throws NullPointerException in a TreeMap is overstated.
findings.fix: Say that a null key throws NullPointerException with natural ordering. A custom Comparator that handles null can allow it.
